QUOTE: "READS ARE UNAFFECTED" — not present; the answer says only "A `code` mismatch means the server process is old, not the index. Only a client restart fixes it." and "Write paths refuse on the code axis. `stale_code_refusal` ... refuses any write when the process predates its source."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes are refused on the code axis, but it never says reads stay current because query tools open the database per call. It also doesn't say a build through a stale process would write old pipeline logic.
